_comment: CANONICAL TEMPLATE for V-JEPA2 ViT-L. This is not the authoritative copy.
The authoritative spec lives beside the weights as <model>.preprocess.json,
because it describes those weights. Copy this file there, verify every
value against the model's shipped config, then set
verified_against_official_config is FALSE and must stay false until someone
has checked these numbers against the actual checkpoint. The mean/std below
are the standard ImageNet statistics that V-JEPA2's published preprocessor
uses, but they were transcribed without the weights present to confirm.
frames/stride/resolution below mirror what the pipeline currently sends,
NOT what the fetched checkpoint expects. scripts/fetch_weights.py pulls
facebook/vjepa2-vitl-fpc64-256, a 64-frame 256px model. Reconciling that is
a measured change and is on the tomorrow list, not applied here.
source: ImageNet statistics per the published V-JEPA2 preprocessor; transcribed without the checkpoint present
